entries.20b7ee4fe2589bef: Its management philosophy is to provide valuable products and services globally through sincerity and the creation of new technologies, and to realize the happiness of the people involved. Its medium-term management plan 'Kasai Turnaround Aspiration', with the fiscal year ending March 2028 as its final year, focuses on three pillars: earnings improvement centered on structural reform of the North American business, creation of free cash flow through improvement of the cash conversion cycle, and building a global organization and global processes; it aims to address key management issues and achieve management recovery.
